newsitem.title: USA: J.E. Robert closes sale of JER unit to Goldman.
newsitem.headline: J.E. Robert closes sale of JER unit to Goldman.

text.p: J.E. Robert Cos, a real estate investment advisory firm, said on Monday it had completed the previously announced sale of its JER division to Goldman, Sachs & Co for an undisclosed sum.

JER has served either as a general partner, co-investor or asset manager for about $1.35 billion of Goldman's partners' equity and Goldman's Whitehall real estate investment funds since 1992, J.E. Roberts said in a statement.

"While JER will remain a limited partner in existing joint ventures with Whitehall, the sale of the division will enable JER to pursue certain opportunities with our other capital partners and expand our principal investing activities," Joseph Robert Jr., J.E. Robert's chief executive officer and chairman, said in a statement.
J.E. Robert said its realized rate of return on real estate investments over the past five years was over 70 percent.
